headline: 生化危机爆发夜领跑，A Prophet首播
summary: 今日影市由《生化危机：爆发夜》《爱情假说》等领跑；剧集方面，《A Prophet》本周首播，与《菜鸟老警》《龙族》等热播剧同场竞争，待映《复仇者联盟5》与新剧《幻视任务》继续预热。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《生化危机：爆发夜》《爱情假说》《明月照他乡》等领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night, The Love Hypothesis, and Moon Shines on His Hometown lead.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集动态：《A Prophet》本周首播；《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》等热播。
industryHighlights.en: TV buzz: A Prophet premieres this week; The Rookie, Rick and Morty, and House of the Dragon stay hot.

industryHighlights.text: 待播待映：《幻视任务》《女巫团学院》《魔女嘉莉》及《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《挖掘者》等受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Vision Quest, Witch Academy, Carrie, Avengers 5, Mongoose, and Digger draw attention.

headlineEn: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night Leads, A Prophet Premieres
summaryEn: Today's film slate is led by Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and The Love Hypothesis; on TV, A Prophet premieres this week and competes with hot series like The Rookie and House of the Dragon, while Avengers 5 and Vision Quest keep buzz building.
